Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the people become ill, add Shennong’s reaction to show why he wants to help: “神农看见他们很难受，心里很着急。”
2. You could describe the plants briefly where Shennong sees them: “路边长着各种各样的植物，有的开着小花。”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting feeling that explains why Shennong wants to help.
It adds a simple, concrete description of the plants without changing the story.
